'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Power outage]]s are reported across Ukraine and citizens are advised to store water as [[Russia]]n [[airstrike]]s across the country continue to damage critical infrastructure and energy facilities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-infrastructure-pounded-again-saturday-2022-10-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**The [[Taliban]] kill six [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|ISIS–K]] members during a raid in [[Kabul]], saying they were responsible for the [[September 2022 Kabul mosque bombing|bombings of a mosque]] [[September 2022 Kabul school bombing|and school]] in the city last month. A Taliban security member is also killed during the raid. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-kill-six-islamic-state-members-raid-afghan-capital-spokesman-2022-10-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fifteen people are killed and 40 others are injured when a bus collides with a truck in [[Rewa district]], [[Madhya Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/modi-india-accidents-297d1652b5e441b78b6a6a1ef012a806 (AP)]
*[[Costa Rica]]n security minister Jorge Torres says that a search is underway for a plane carrying five [[Germans|German citizens]] and a [[Switzerland|Swiss]] pilot, which disappeared near the city of [[Limón, Costa Rica|Limón]]. Among the passengers on board is [[Rainer Schaller]], CEO of [[McFit]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/plane-carrying-mcfit-gym-tycoon-rainer-schaller-disappears-reports/a-63525312 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/costa-rica-search-underway-missing-plane-carrying-five-germans-2022-10-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party]]
**The 20th [[National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party|National Congress]] of the [[Chinese Communist Party|Communist Party]] closes in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. The party's new 205-member [[Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party|Central Committee]], elected by delegates at the end of the week-long congress, did not include outgoing [[Premier of the People's Republic of China|Premier]] [[Li Keqiang]] or former [[Guangdong]] [[Chinese Communist Party Committee Secretary|party secretary]] [[Wang Yang (politician)|Wang Yang]], who had been seen as a potential replacement as premier. The Сongress has been described as strengthening the power of [[Xi Jinping]], who is likely to be re-elected as [[General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party|General Secretary]] tomorrow. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-communist-party-congress-closes-cementing-xis-status-core-2022-10-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Italian government formation]]
**[[Brothers of Italy]] leader [[Giorgia Meloni]] is sworn in as [[Prime Minister of Italy]], becoming the [[List of the first women holders of political offices in Europe#Italy|first woman]] to hold the position. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/far-right-leader-giorgia-meloni-sworn-in-as-italian-premier/2022/10/22/4ae28b3c-51e3-11ed-ada8-04e6e6bf8b19_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**More than 80,000 people take part in a rally in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], to show their solidarity with protesters in [[Iran]]. [https://france24.com/en/live-news/20221022-berlin-rally-for-iran-draws-80-000 (France 24)]
*[[Opposition to Brexit]]
**Thousands of protesters march in [[London]] to protest the alleged [[economic effects of Brexit]] and to demand that the [[United Kingdom]] [[Potential enlargement of the European Union|rejoin]] the [[European Union|EU]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/oct/22/thousands-of-london-protesters-call-for-uk-to-rejoin-eu (''The Guardian'')]
